# The stencil's shape, measured on the HOME hand masks

git 085c99d; camera `AIM_4A8B6118_BOXFIT`; 12 barrels (no flag, box overlapping no other box) of 16 HOME train frames with a hand mask.
Each barrel's stripe rows are read off its mask; the camera model gives the barrel whose stripe centre is at that row; the hand-drawn box is compared with it.

## What was chosen, and by which rule

| number | value | rule | the numbers behind it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `top_fit` (px added to the model's top row: a + b x width) | (1.96, 0.0) | the line if it predicts left-out scenes better than the median by more than 10 % | median 1.96, line [4.19, -0.0407]; left-one-scene-out error 1.16 px (median) against 1.27 px (line) |
| `bottom_fit` | (-4.62, 0.0887) | same | median 0.12, line [-4.62, 0.0887]; 1.98 px against 1.17 px |
| `seam` (share of the stripe height not looked at, each side of a band edge) | 0.1 | (1 - 10th percentile of stripe height / model) / 2 | stripe height / model: median 0.83, 10th percentile 0.80 |
| `rim` (share of the width, each side, with rounded corners) | 0.208 | columns where the first 1/8 of the upper body and the last 1/8 of the lower body are under half painted | 5.0 of 24 columns |
| `rim_top` | 0.125 | in the rim columns, the share of upper-body rows from the top that are under half painted | |
| `rim_bottom` | 0.333 | the same for the lower body, from the bottom | |

Box width / model width: median 0.98, 0.91 to 1.06. The model's width is used as it is.
